title: The Clotted Set
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, the clotted growth from the dead end worn instead of left there.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now set a clotted growth into a charm for the neck and press a sliver of it into a band for the finger, keel shards worked in to hold the shape.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking keel shards, for anyone who would rather buy than mine them off the ridge.

items.name: Clotted charm
items.examine: A clotted growth strung on cord, worn close to the throat.

items.name: Clotted band
items.examine: A sliver of clotted growth, bent round and closed. Fits like it grew there.
